name: Tommy Smith
role: Cowpuncher on the E6 ranch and other outfits
bio: Tommy Smith rode as a cowpuncher for the E6 ranch in 1885, reporting in August that about 4,000 steers would be shipped from that range, and in early 1886 returned to the W L ranch on Powder river. In October 1886 he came in from a season's work on the trail and in the British Possessions, and that winter he was in Deadwood.
